failed_or_abandoned: First run with a 128x96 angular grid, 6-day sampling and numerical integration for every component: ~2.5 min per component, exceeded 10 min; stopped. Replaced by the exact closed-form speed density for isotropic untruncated streams, a windowed 96x64 grid for anisotropic/truncated components and 12-day sampling (33 days incl. 16 June and 2 Dec).
12-day-grid argmax as the rate peak day (157 for all curves) replaced by first-harmonic least-squares fits (peak 152.5-153.7).
Two-lobe (+-250 km/s) Sausage variant of P030 not rerun; SHM++ anisotropic form used instead (reproduces P018's 0.80).
